children: South Korea plans to merge five public power companies in October 2027 to speed up investment and meet rising energy demand from the country’s artificial intelligence and chip manufacturing industries. According to ChainCatcher, Seoul also plans to streamline state-owned enterprises in the oil, gas, and port sectors.

title: South Korea Plans 2027 Merger of Five Public Power Companies
